title: Stay at 402 Rosemary Beach Inn | Our Luxury Rosemary Beach Condo – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: 402 Rosemary Beach Inn is one of our more popular Rosemary Beach Condos, offering gulf views, luxury furnishings, and so much more! Click to book today!
description_expanded:
Conveniently located near Town Center and Beach

Celebration of the evening sunset is not just a pastime at Rosemary Beach...it is a way of life. The suite offers unobstructed western views of the shimmering Gulf of Mexico waters from the intimate Cucinino.

The living room features a queen-size sofa sleeper, LED flat screen television with Blu-Ray DVD player, study desk and chair. The Cucinino, or small kitchen, provides an undercounter refrigerator, sink, microwave, and Keurig K-cup coffee brewer. A contemporary king platform bed in the bedroom offers a pillow-top king mattress with 400-count sheets and Cuddledown comforter.

Access to the third floor by elevator, and one flight of stairs to the fourth floor.

All Rosemary Beach Inn rooms feature free Wi-Fi service, free DVD rentals, and FloWater system.

**This property requires a 2 night minimum stay.**

**1 set of Complimentary Beach Chairs included on full days of your stay (arrival and departure date can be added for an additional fee).**

**Street parking only. **
